meta.scope: Educational demo data for GED Travel Agency
meta.note: All prices are illustrative and not bookable. This is an educational school project.

packages.name: The City Experience
packages.tagline: Canada's biggest city, on your own terms.
highlights: Skyline views from the CN Tower
packages.description: Downtown energy, Yorkville, skyline views, waterfront walks and Canada's biggest-city atmosphere — all in one compact trip.

packages.name: Wild by Design
packages.description: Mountain landscapes, Banff, outdoor adventures and premium alpine stays — built around the wild side of Canada.

packages.name: Old Soul
packages.description: Historic streets, architecture, local food and a slower European-inspired rhythm in North America's oldest walled city.

packages.name: Pacific Edge
packages.description: Ocean, mountains, modern neighbourhoods and West Coast energy — Vancouver and Victoria in one continuous journey.

packages.name: NHL Eastern Road Trip
packages.tagline: Three arenas. Two languages. One obsession.
packages.description: Follow the Original Six energy across Ontario and Quebec — Toronto, Ottawa and Montréal in one epic hockey journey.

packages.name: NHL Western Circuit
packages.tagline: From the Pacific to the Prairies.
packages.description: The ultimate western hockey pilgrimage — four NHL arenas, four cities, and the Canadian Rockies along the way.

packages.name: CFL Stadium Tour
packages.description: Experience the uniquely Canadian game — bigger field, three downs, and a stadium culture all its own.

packages.name: Music East
packages.tagline: Jazz, indie and everything in between.
packages.description: Two cities, two music scenes — Montréal's jazz legacy and Toronto's indie energy in one festival-focused trip.

packages.name: Rockies Ski Week
packages.description: Ski the legendary powder of Banff and Lake Louise — three resorts, one unforgettable mountain week.

packages.name: Laurentians Ski Escape
packages.description: A colourful pedestrian village at the base of one of eastern Canada's best ski mountains.

packages.name: Polar Bear Capital
packages.tagline: Face to face with the Arctic.
packages.description: The polar bear capital of the world — where Hudson Bay meets the Arctic tundra.

packages.name: Aurora Nights
packages.description: Yellowknife is one of the best places on Earth to see the aurora borealis — 95% success rate.

packages.name: Yukon Aurora & Wilderness
packages.tagline: Where the road ends and the lights begin.
packages.description: Whitehorse combines aurora viewing with true Yukon wilderness — dogsledding, hot springs, and endless skies.

packages.name: Rockies by Rail
packages.tagline: The most scenic train ride in the world.
packages.description: The legendary Rocky Mountaineer — two days of glass-domed train travel through the heart of the Rockies.

packages.name: Québec Food & Wine
packages.tagline: Eat your way through French Canada.
packages.description: Two cities, endless flavour — from Montréal's multicultural food corridors to Québec's farm-to-table traditions.

packages.name: UNESCO Ontario
packages.description: Rideau Canal, Fort Henry and Canada's capital — UNESCO history at every turn.

packages.name: Atlantic UNESCO Trail
packages.description: Viking settlements, ancient fossils and Atlantic fjords — the wildest UNESCO trail in Canada.

stadiums.name: Commonwealth Stadium
stadiums.notable: Largest stadium in Canada by capacity. Hosted 1978 Commonwealth Games, 2001 IAAF World Championships, and the 2010 Heritage Classic.

stadiums.name: Olympic Stadium
stadiums.notable: Built for the 1976 Summer Olympics. Features the tallest inclined tower in the world (Montreal Tower, 175m).

stadiums.name: BC Place
stadiums.notable: Largest stadium in Western Canada. Retractable roof. Hosted 2010 Winter Olympics ceremonies and the 2015 FIFA Women's World Cup final.

stadiums.name: Rogers Centre
stadiums.notable: First stadium in the world with a fully retractable roof. Home of the Toronto Blue Jays.

stadiums.name: McMahon Stadium
stadiums.notable: Home of the Calgary Stampeders since 1960. Hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics opening ceremony.

stadiums.name: Mosaic Stadium
stadiums.notable: Modern home of the Saskatchewan Roughriders, known for its passionate fan base.

stadiums.name: BMO Field
stadiums.notable: Expanded for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Home of Toronto FC and the Argonauts.

stadiums.name: TD Place Stadium
stadiums.notable: Built on the site of the historic Lansdowne Park. Hosted the 2017 Grey Cup.

stadiums.name: Tim Hortons Field
stadiums.notable: Built for the 2015 Pan American Games. Home of the Tiger-Cats.

stadiums.name: Percival Molson Memorial Stadium
stadiums.notable: One of the oldest stadiums in North America, set on the slopes of Mount Royal.

stadiums.name: Princess Auto Stadium
stadiums.notable: Modern stadium with a canopy covering 80% of seats. Home of the Blue Bombers.

stadiums.name: Percy Perry Stadium
stadiums.notable: Modern soccer-specific stadium in Langley, home of Vancouver FC.

arenas.name: Bell Centre
arenas.notable: Largest NHL arena in Canada. Home of the Canadiens — 24 Stanley Cup banners hang from the rafters.

arenas.name: Scotiabank Arena
arenas.notable: One of the busiest arenas in the world. Home of the Maple Leafs and Raptors.

arenas.name: Rogers Arena
arenas.notable: Home of the Vancouver Canucks, in the heart of downtown Vancouver.

arenas.name: Scotiabank Saddledome
arenas.notable: Iconic saddle-shaped roof. Home of the Flames since 1983.

arenas.name: Rogers Place
arenas.notable: Modern arena in the Ice District. Home of Connor McDavid and the Oilers.

arenas.name: Canada Life Centre
arenas.notable: Home of the Winnipeg Jets. Known for its loud, passionate crowds.

arenas.name: Canadian Tire Centre
arenas.notable: Home of the Ottawa Senators. Frequently visited by Canadiens fans — creating one of the NHL's most unique atmospheres.

arenas.name: Budweiser Gardens
arenas.notable: One of the top junior hockey arenas in Canada. Home of the London Knights.

national_parks.name: Banff National Park
national_parks.highlight: Canada's first national park. Turquoise lakes, glaciers and the Icefields Parkway.

national_parks.name: Jasper National Park
national_parks.highlight: Largest national park in the Rockies. Dark-sky preserve.

national_parks.name: Yoho National Park
national_parks.highlight: Takakkaw Falls, Emerald Lake and the Burgess Shale fossils.

national_parks.name: Kootenay National Park
national_parks.highlight: Radium Hot Springs, Marble Canyon and the Paint Pots.

national_parks.name: Gros Morne National Park
national_parks.highlight: UNESCO site with fjords, cliffs and ancient geological formations.

national_parks.name: Fundy National Park
national_parks.highlight: Highest tides in the world. Coastal cliffs and Acadian forest.

national_parks.name: Cape Breton Highlands National Park
national_parks.highlight: Cabot Trail, coastal cliffs and Acadian culture.

national_parks.name: Prince Edward Island National Park
national_parks.highlight: Red-sand beaches, dunes and Green Gables heritage.

national_parks.name: Riding Mountain National Park
national_parks.highlight: Boreal forest, prairies and the historic Wasagaming townsite.

national_parks.name: Wood Buffalo National Park
national_parks.highlight: Largest national park in Canada. Home to free-roaming bison.

national_parks.name: Nahanni National Park Reserve
national_parks.highlight: Virginia Falls (twice the height of Niagara), canyons and whitewater.

national_parks.name: Kluane National Park
national_parks.highlight: Mount Logan (Canada's highest peak) and vast icefields.

national_parks.name: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve
national_parks.highlight: Wild Pacific coastline, temperate rainforest and storm-watching.

national_parks.name: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve
national_parks.highlight: Haida heritage sites, ancient totem poles and remote islands.

national_parks.name: Torngat Mountains National Park
national_parks.highlight: Arctic landscapes, Inuit culture and polar bears.

national_parks.name: Auyuittuq National Park
national_parks.highlight: Arctic fjords, glaciers and Mount Thor — world's tallest vertical cliff.

national_parks.name: Sirmilik National Park
national_parks.highlight: Bylot Island bird cliffs, glaciers and floe-edge safaris.

unesco_sites.description: 11th-century Viking settlement — earliest documented European presence in the New World.

unesco_sites.name: Nahanni National Park
unesco_sites.description: Outstanding geomorphological features, canyons and Virginia Falls.

unesco_sites.name: Dinosaur Provincial Park
unesco_sites.description: One of the most important dinosaur fossil sites in the world.

unesco_sites.name: Kluane / Wrangell-St. Elias / Glacier Bay / Tatshenshini-Alsek
unesco_sites.description: Transnational parks with the largest non-polar icefield in the world.

unesco_sites.name: Head-Smashed-In Buffalo Jump
unesco_sites.description: Indigenous buffalo jump used for nearly 6,000 years.

unesco_sites.name: Wood Buffalo National Park
unesco_sites.description: Largest national park in Canada, home to wild bison and whooping cranes.

unesco_sites.name: Canadian Rocky Mountain Parks
unesco_sites.description: Banff, Jasper, Yoho, Kootenay and the Burgess Shale fossil site.

unesco_sites.name: Historic District of Old Québec
unesco_sites.description: Only remaining fortified city north of Mexico. French-Canadian heritage.

unesco_sites.name: Gros Morne National Park
unesco_sites.description: Fjords, cliffs and ancient geological formations.

unesco_sites.name: SG̱ang Gwaay (Anthony Island)
unesco_sites.description: Haida village with standing totem poles and longhouses.

unesco_sites.name: Miguasha National Park
unesco_sites.description: World's most outstanding fossil record of the Devonian 'Age of Fishes'.

unesco_sites.name: Rideau Canal
unesco_sites.description: UNESCO canal — world's largest skating rink every winter.

unesco_sites.name: Joggins Fossil Cliffs
unesco_sites.description: World's most complete fossil record of the Carboniferous period.

unesco_sites.name: Grand-Pré
unesco_sites.description: Acadian deportation site and cultural landscape.

unesco_sites.name: Mistaken Point
unesco_sites.description: Ediacaran fossils — some of the oldest complex life forms on Earth.

unesco_sites.name: Pimachiowin Aki
unesco_sites.description: Indigenous cultural landscape and boreal forest.

unesco_sites.name: Tr'ondëk-Klondike
unesco_sites.description: Klondike Gold Rush heritage and Tr'ondëk Hwëch'in culture.

unesco_sites.name: Anticosti
unesco_sites.description: Fossil-rich island documenting the first mass extinction.

festivals.name: Calgary Stampede
festivals.description: The Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth — rodeo, chuckwagons and live music.

festivals.name: Montréal International Jazz Festival
festivals.description: World's largest jazz festival — hundreds of free outdoor concerts.

festivals.name: Osheaga
festivals.description: Three-day indie, pop and electronic festival on Île Sainte-Hélène.

festivals.name: Toronto International Film Festival
festivals.description: One of the world's biggest public film festivals — premieres, red carpets and Q&As.

festivals.name: Toronto Caribbean Carnival
festivals.description: North America's largest Caribbean festival — parade, soca and food.

festivals.name: Québec Winter Carnival
festivals.description: World's largest winter carnival — ice palace, parades and Bonhomme.

festivals.name: Winterlude
festivals.description: Ice sculptures, skating on the Rideau Canal and winter celebrations.

festivals.name: Canadian Tulip Festival
festivals.description: Over one million tulips bloom across the capital every spring.

festivals.name: Canadian Grand Prix
festivals.description: Formula 1 weekend on the Circuit Gilles Villeneuve.

festivals.name: Vancouver Celebration of Light
festivals.description: International fireworks competition over English Bay.

festivals.name: Banff Mountain Film Festival
festivals.description: World tour of adventure, environment and mountain-culture films.

festivals.name: Northern Lights Nights
festivals.description: Guided aurora viewing under some of the clearest skies on Earth.

festivals.name: Toonik Tyme
festivals.description: Nunavut's spring festival — Inuit games, dog sled races and northern traditions.

ski_resorts.name: Whistler Blackcomb
ski_resorts.description: Largest ski area in North America. Hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics.

ski_resorts.name: Lake Louise Ski Resort
ski_resorts.description: Legendary Rockies skiing with views of Victoria Glacier.

ski_resorts.name: Sunshine Village
ski_resorts.description: Banff's highest ski resort. Long season, dry powder.

ski_resorts.name: Mont-Tremblant
ski_resorts.description: Eastern Canada's premier resort. Colourful pedestrian village.

ski_resorts.name: Fernie Alpine Resort
ski_resorts.description: Legendary powder. Voted Best Ski Resort in Canada.

food_experiences.name: Montréal Food Tour
food_experiences.description: Bagels, smoked meat, poutine and Jean-Talon Market.

food_experiences.name: Québec City Culinary Walk
food_experiences.description: Farm-to-table, ice cider and French-Canadian classics.

food_experiences.name: Okanagan Wine Tour
food_experiences.description: Canada's first UNESCO City of Gastronomy. Vineyards and farm-to-table.

food_experiences.name: Niagara Wine Route
food_experiences.description: Ice wine, VQA wines and scenic vineyard drives.

wildlife_experiences.name: Polar Bear Tundra Buggy
wildlife_experiences.description: Tundra buggy tours to see wild polar bears up close.

wildlife_experiences.name: Beluga Whale Watching
wildlife_experiences.description: Kayak or boat with thousands of beluga whales in Hudson Bay.

wildlife_experiences.name: Pacific Whale Watching
wildlife_experiences.description: Grey whales, humpbacks, orcas and sea otters.

wildlife_experiences.name: Grizzly Bear Viewing
wildlife_experiences.description: Watch grizzly bears fish for salmon in remote river valleys.

northern_lights.name: Yellowknife Aurora Viewing
northern_lights.description: One of the best places on Earth to see the aurora borealis.

northern_lights.name: Whitehorse Aurora & Hot Springs
northern_lights.description: Aurora viewing combined with Eclipse Nordic Hot Springs.

northern_lights.name: Churchill Aurora & Wildlife
northern_lights.description: Combine aurora viewing with polar bear and beluga experiences.

train_experiences.name: Rocky Mountaineer
train_experiences.description: The most scenic train ride in the world. Glass-domed carriages.

train_experiences.name: The Canadian (VIA Rail)
train_experiences.description: Cross-country train journey through the Canadian Shield and Rockies.

train_experiences.name: The Ocean (VIA Rail)
train_experiences.description: Atlantic Canada by rail — forests, rivers and maritime landscapes.

experiences.name: CN Tower EdgeWalk
experiences.description: Walk on the edge of the world's tallest free-standing structure.

experiences.name: Niagara Falls Boat Tour
experiences.description: Get soaked at the base of one of the world's great waterfalls.

experiences.name: CN Tower 360 Restaurant
experiences.description: Dine 351 metres above the city in a rotating restaurant.

experiences.name: Dogsledding Adventure
experiences.description: Mush your own team through pristine winter landscapes.

experiences.name: Ice Fishing Experience
experiences.description: Fish through the ice on a frozen lake — a true Canadian winter ritual.

experiences.name: Sea Kayaking
experiences.description: Paddle through temperate rainforest and Pacific coastline.

experiences.name: Heli-Skiing
experiences.description: Helicopter access to untouched powder in the Canadian Rockies.

experiences.name: Hot Springs Soak
experiences.description: Soak in natural hot springs surrounded by mountain scenery.

experiences.name: Ice Canyon Walk
experiences.description: Walk through frozen waterfalls and blue ice canyons.
